# Supreme Villagio Somatane — Full Knowledge Dossier & Deep RAG Dataset

## 1. Project Context & Positioning
Supreme Villagio is an ultra-luxury master-planned 16-acre low-density villa estate located in Somatane, Pune West, developed by Supreme Universal. Somatane sits at an altitude of 616 meters along the Western Ghats mountain ridges, providing cooler temperatures (2–4°C lower than central Pune) and clean mountain air index while remaining 20 minutes from Hinjewadi IT Park and 25 minutes from Baner.

## 2. Developer Pedigree: Supreme Universal
Supreme Universal has delivered over 75+ landmark luxury residential and commercial projects across Mumbai and Pune over four decades. Notable developments in Pune include Supreme Estia (Baner), Supreme Amadore (Baner), Supreme Adima (Baner), and Supreme Pallacio.

## 3. Product Typologies & Engineering Specifications
- **4 BHK Premium Townhouses:**
  - Carpet Area: 2,200 – 2,400 sq.ft.
  - Structure: Ground + 2 Floors with exclusive rooftop party terrace.
  - Price: Starting ₹2.89 Cr*.
- **4 BHK Luxury Twin Villas:**
  - Carpet Area: 2,600 – 2,900 sq.ft.
  - Plot Feature: 3-side open private landscaped lawn and breakfast patio.
  - Features: Double-height formal living room, walk-in master suite dressing.
  - Price: Starting ₹3.45 Cr*.
- **5 BHK Grand Presidential Villas (Limited 19 Units):**
  - Carpet Area: 3,400 – 3,900 sq.ft.
  - Plot Feature: Elevated hillside plots with panoramic Sahyadri views.
  - Features: Private elevator from ground to sky lounge, 3 covered vehicle bays with EV charging.
  - Price: Starting ₹4.85 Cr*.

## 4. Phase Architecture & MahaRERA Compliance
- **Phase I (P52100046867):** Fully Completed & Handed Over. Full Occupation Certificate (OC) granted.
- **Phase II (P52100049506):** Fully Completed & Handed Over. Full Occupation Certificate (OC) granted.
- **Phase III (P52100055048):** Newly Launched Under Construction. Statutory MahaRERA Completion Schedule: December 31, 2028.

## 5. Amenities & Masterplan Architecture
- **Club Villagio:** 18,500 sq.ft. operational clubhouse.
- **Facilities:** Olympic-size swimming pool, heated kids pool, badminton court, squash court, fitness center, banquet halls, multi-cuisine cafe, indoor games room, massage suites.
- **Landscape Master Planner:** Site Concepts International (Singapore). Over 65% open green space with central wellness spine, aromatic gardens, reflexology path, and children's adventure park.

## 6. Commute & Connectivity Matrix
- Hinjewadi IT Park: 20–25 Mins via Mumbai-Pune Expressway & NH-48.
- Baner & Balewadi High Street: 25–30 Mins.
- Talegaon MIDC: 10–12 Mins.
- Mumbai–Pune Expressway Toll Plaza: 3 Mins.
- Lonavala: 30 Mins.
- Navi Mumbai International Airport: 75–85 Mins.
